description: Map the full DMD clinical trial portfolio onto canonical vs alternative mechanism classes (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2)
code:
import requests, json, re, time, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

# ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, retrieved 2026-11-25
base="https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies"
params={"query.cond":"Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy","filter.overallStatus":"","pageSize":1000,
        "fields":"NCTId,BriefTitle,OverallStatus,Phase,StudyType,InterventionName,InterventionType,StartDate,EnrollmentCount,PrimaryOutcomeMeasure"}
params.pop("filter.overallStatus")
studies=[]; token=None
while True:
    p=dict(params)
    if token: p["pageToken"]=token
    r=requests.get(base, params=p, timeout=120); j=r.json()
    studies+=j.get("studies",[]); token=j.get("nextPageToken")
    if not token: break
    time.sleep(0.2)
print("studies retrieved:", len(studies))
json.dump(studies, open("clinicaltrials_dmd_v2_snapshot.json","w"))

def flat(s):
    ps=s.get("protocolSection",{})
    ivs=ps.get("armsInterventionsModule",{}).get("interventions",[]) or []
    return dict(nct=ps.get("identificationModule",{}).get("nctId"),
        title=ps.get("identificationModule",{}).get("briefTitle",""),
        status=ps.get("statusModule",{}).get("overallStatus"),
        start=(ps.get("statusModule",{}).get("startDateStruct",{}) or {}).get("date"),
        stype=ps.get("designModule",{}).get("studyType"),
        phases=";".join(ps.get("designModule",{}).get("phases",[]) or []),
        enroll=(ps.get("designModule",{}).get("enrollmentInfo",{}) or {}).get("count"),
        ivs="; ".join(f"{i.get('type')}:{i.get('name')}" for i in ivs))
df=pd.DataFrame([flat(s) for s in studies])
df["text"]=(df.title.fillna("")+" "+df.ivs.fillna("")).str.lower()

MECH = {
 "Dystrophin restoration (exon skipping)": r"exon.?skip|eteplirsen|golodirsen|viltolarsen|casimersen|drisapersen|suvodirsen|antisense oligo|ataluren|translarna|readthrough|renadirsen|brogidirsen|\bnS-?065|srp-?501|srp-?502|srp-?503|srp-?504|srp-?505|srp-?5051",
 "Dystrophin restoration (gene transfer/editing)": r"micro-?dystrophin|microdystrophin|minidystrophin|delandistrogene|elevidys|srp-?9001|sgt-?００３|sgt-?003|pf-?06939926|fordadistrogene|rgx-?202|crispr|gene (therapy|transfer|editing)|aav",
 "Dystrophin surrogate (utrophin/laminin)": r"utrophin|ezutromid|smt c1100|laminin|biglycan|tvn-?102",
 "Anti-inflammatory / immunomodulation": r"cortico(steroid)?|prednis|deflazacort|vamorolone|emflaza|ifetroban|edasalonexent|nf-?kb|tamoxifen|rimeporide|pamrevlumab|infliximab|hydroxychloroquine|cd-?nf|canakinumab",
 "Calcium / oxidative stress handling": r"calcium|ryanodine|rycal|s48168|aryl|idebenone|coenzyme q|n-?acetylcysteine|antioxidant|epicatechin|mitochond|taurine",
 "Fibrosis / ECM": r"fibro|pamrevlumab|ctgf|halofuginone|losartan|spironolactone|givinostat|hdac|tgf-?beta",
 "Muscle mass / anabolic (myostatin, IGF)": r"myostatin|follistatin|domagrozumab|taldefgrobep|ace-?031|bimagrumab|igf-?1|mk-?0773|oxandrolone|testosterone",
 "Cardiac-directed": r"cardio|eplerenone|carvedilol|lisinopril|enalapril|ace inhibitor|heart failure|sacubitril|ivabradine",
 "Vascular / nNOS-NO pathway": r"sildenafil|tadalafil|nitric oxide|pde5|nitrate|naproxcinod|l-?arginine|hct-?1026",
 "Cell therapy / regeneration": r"stem cell|myoblast|mesenchymal|cardiosphere|cap-?1002|deramiocel|satellite cell",
 "Metabolic / other small molecule": r"metformin|citrulline|creatine|glutamine|vitamin|ursodeoxy|ldn-?|carnitine|ketone",
}
def assign(t):
    hits=[k for k,p in MECH.items() if re.search(p,t)]
    return hits or ["Unclassified / supportive, device, observational"]
df["mechs"]=df.text.map(assign)

inter = df[df.stype=="INTERVENTIONAL"].copy()
rows=[]
for _,r in inter.iterrows():
    for m in r.mechs: rows.append(dict(nct=r.nct,mech=m,phases=r.phases,start=r.start,enroll=r.enroll))
md=pd.DataFrame(rows)
cnt=md.groupby("mech").nct.nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nInterventional DMD trials:", inter.nct.nunique())
print(cnt.to_string())
canon = {"Dystrophin restoration (exon skipping)","Dystrophin restoration (gene transfer/editing)","Dystrophin surrogate (utrophin/laminin)"}
n_canon = md[md.mech.isin(canon)].nct.nunique()
n_down  = md[md.mech.isin({"Anti-inflammatory / immunomodulation","Fibrosis / ECM","Calcium / oxidative stress handling","Muscle mass / anabolic (myostatin, IGF)","Cell therapy / regeneration","Vascular / nNOS-NO pathway"})].nct.nunique()
print(f"\nTrials targeting dystrophin restoration/replacement (upstream canonical): {n_canon}")
print(f"Trials targeting downstream/parallel mechanisms: {n_down}")
print(f"Total interventional: {inter.nct.nunique()}")
df.to_csv("clinicaltrials_dmd_classified.csv", index=False)

# time trend of canonical vs downstream trial starts
inter["year"]=pd.to_numeric(inter.start.str[:4], errors="coerce")
inter["is_canon"]=inter.mechs.map(lambda L: any(m in canon for m in L))
tr=inter.dropna(subset=["year"]).groupby([ "year","is_canon"]).nct.nunique().unstack(fill_value=0)
tr=tr[tr.index>=2000]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
cnt.sort_values().plot(kind="barh", ax=axes[0], color="#4C72B0")
axes[0].set_xlabel("unique interventional trials"); axes[0].set_title("DMD interventional trial portfolio by target mechanism\n(ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, snapshot 2026-11-25)")
for i,v in enumerate(cnt.sort_values().values): axes[0].text(v+0.5,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=8)
if tr.shape[1]==2:
    axes[1].plot(tr.index, tr[True], marker="o", label="dystrophin restoration/surrogate", color="#55A868")
    axes[1].plot(tr.index, tr[False], marker="s", label="downstream / parallel mechanism", color="#C44E52")
axes[1].set_xlabel("trial start year"); axes[1].set_ylabel("new interventional trials"); axes[1].legend(fontsize=9)
axes[1].set_title("Upstream vs downstream targeting over time")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nfiles:", [f for f in os.listdir('.') if f.endswith(('.csv','.json'))])
